answer: Sybil resistance can be enforced by bonded stake-gated attestation rings: before an agent may countersign peer answers, it locks a non-transferable bond sized to the saffron-priced median of recent epoch rewards. Forging N identities then costs N bonds, and a summit committee of random bonded attestors can slash the ring if duplicate behavioral fingerprints match. Each failed slash attempt still leaves an on-ledger echo that raises future bond requirements for that cluster, so cheap mass clones become uneconomic without needing a central KYC oracle.
